ns2:course.label: Introductory Chemistry
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the basic concepts and language of chemistry; lectures, discussions, and lab. Preparatory chemistry course for students who require additional background before enrolling in CHEM 102. This course has been approved for graduation credit for all students in the College of LAS. Students in other colleges should check with their college office. Prerequisite: 2.5 years of high school mathematics, or credit or concurrent registration in MATH 012.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: 2.5 years of high school mathematics, or credit or concurrent registration in MATH 012.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students may take CHEM 101 as part of their general education sequence in physical science. Students must register for one lab-discussion and one lecture section.
